fields.description: Master switch for the SCHEDULED fetch / submit passes. Manual imports and test batches run regardless. Ships off so a fresh deploy never starts writing on its own.
fields.label: Scheduled sync enabled

fields.description: Live MySQL reads the Ingress machine over the LAN. Snapshot CSV reads a gzipped export - use it when off-LAN.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: Path INSIDE the frappe container. Only used when Source is Snapshot CSV.
fields.label: Snapshot path

fields.description: The PC running FingerTec Ingress ("Natalie") and its MySQL service. Read-only credentials - CAF never writes to the machine.
fields.label: Ingress machine (Natalie)

fields.description: IP address of the Natalie PC on the CAF LAN. ⚠️ This MUST be a STATIC/reserved address. If Natalie is on DHCP its address can change on any reboot or lease expiry, and every import then fails with a connection timeout - which looks like the machine being off rather than a network change.
fields.label: Natalie IP address

fields.description: MySQL port on Natalie. 3306 is the default. (Not 4370 - that is the port the fingerprint devices use to talk to the Ingress software, and ERPNext never uses it.)
fields.label: MySQL port

fields.description: Fetch re-reads work dates from D-minus-this back to the to-day below. A wide window is the point: every date is re-read many times before it is ever submitted.
fields.label: Fetch from D-

fields.description: The submit pass only touches this one work date - old enough that the machine has settled and any OT Approval has been filed.
fields.label: Submit work date D-

fields.description: A draft held back by a missing OT Approval, an incomplete punch record or an unconfirmed roster month gets flagged for HR once it is older than this. 0 disables the flagging.
fields.label: Flag held drafts after (days)
